title: Bill to merge SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore into a new Skills and Workforce Development Agency
what_it_is: A Bill at Second Reading to establish the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) by merging SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore and transferring their functions, employees and assets.
why_it_matters: The Bill establishes SWDA as a statutory board whose functions cover the existing functions of SSG and WSG and extend to promoting career and employment services and training. If passed, SWDA will be established in the third quarter of 2026, and employees of WSG and SSG will transfer on terms no less favourable than their present ones. The Minister said SSG's and WSG's operations will be fully undertaken by SWDA from Day One, with existing grant and employment assistance commitments honoured.

key_points.point: The Minister moved that the Bill be now read a Second time.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: That the Bill be now read a Second time.

key_points.point: At Budget 2026, the Prime Minister announced the merger of SSG and WSG into a new statutory board jointly overseen by MOE and MOM.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: At Budget 2026, the Prime Minister announced that we will merge SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) and Workforce Singapore (WSG) into a new Statutory Board jointly overseen by the Ministry of Education (MOE) and the Ministry of Manpower (MOM).

key_points.point: The new agency will be called the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA).
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We will call the new agency the "Skills and Workforce Development Agency" (SWDA).

key_points.point: SWDA's functions will cover the existing functions of SSG and WSG and extend to promoting the development of career and employment services and training in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: SWDA's functions will cover the existing functions of SSG and WSG, and extend them to include promoting the development of career and employment services and training in Singapore.

key_points.point: Employees of WSG and SSG will transfer to SWDA on terms no less favourable than their present ones.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Employees of WSG and SSG will be transferred to SWDA on terms that are no less favourable than their present ones.

key_points.point: Parts 10 and 11 repeal the SSG Act and WSG Act and make consequential amendments, including to the Private Education Act and Skills Development Levy Act, which SWDA will administer.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The key amendments are to the Private Education Act and Skills Development Levy Act, which will be administered by SWDA.

key_points.point: If the Bill is passed, SWDA will be established in the third quarter of 2026.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: If the Bill is passed, SWDA will be established in the third quarter of 2026 as a cornerstone in answering our workforce challenges in the decade ahead.

key_points.point: The merger does not require additional budget allocation; branding, marketing and systems integration costs will be managed within existing budgets and reserves.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: These costs will be managed within the existing budgets of SSG and WSG, and their reserves.

key_points.point: MOM will be the parent Ministry of SWDA, with joint oversight with MOE.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: MOM will be the parent Ministry of SWDA, but the joint oversight arrangement with MOE, that means between myself and Minister Desmond Lee, will bring the IHLs into closer alignment with our workforce agenda, ensuring that skills development is pursued in a coherent way.

key_points.point: MyCareersFuture will continue as the national jobs bank, with over 60,000 job postings today and an aspiration to reach 100,000 in 12 months from SWDA's establishment.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We aspire to reach 100,000 job postings in 12 months from SWDA's establishment.

key_points.point: Applicants with verified credentials are 1.5 times more likely to be shortlisted by hirers.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Applicants with verified credentials are 1.5 times more likely to be shortlisted by hirers.

key_points.point: About nine in 10 Career Conversion Programme participants remain employed 24 months after the programme, and about six in 10 earn more than their last drawn salaries.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: For example, about nine in 10 Career Conversion Programme participants remain employed 24 months after embarking on the programme, and about six in 10 of those who participated in these Career Conversion Programmes earn more than their last drawn salaries.

key_points.point: SSG's and WSG's operations will be fully undertaken by SWDA from Day One, with uninterrupted service delivery and existing grant and employment assistance commitments honoured.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: I would like assure Members that SSG's and WSG's operations will be fully undertaken by SWDA from Day One.

key_points.point: SWDA will be organised by stakeholder segments so frontline staff can provide more holistic support across jobs and skills.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We will organise SWDA by stakeholder segments so that those at the frontline can provide more holistic support across jobs and skills for their clients.

key_points.point: At Budget 2026, the Prime Minister announced free access to premium AI tools for those who take up selected training courses, which SWDA will deliver in the coming months.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: At Budget 2026, the Prime Minister announced the latest addition to SWDA's offering – free access to premium AI tools for those who take up selected training courses.

key_points.point: SWDA will work with IHLs and MOE to bring industry exposure upstream so students have a clearer picture of the labour market before they graduate.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: SWDA will work with IHLs and MOE to bring industry exposure upstream so that our students can have a clearer picture of the labour market well before they graduate.

key_points.point: The user journey across digital touchpoints, including MyCareersFuture and MySkillsFuture, will be holistically reviewed for a more seamless experience.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we will holistically review the user journey across digital touchpoints to build a more seamless user experience with better signposting to guide users to the appropriate digital services.

key_points.point: The SWDA Board will draw from diverse backgrounds, including public sector representatives, senior business leaders and key partners such as NTUC, SNEF and trade associations and chambers.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The Board will draw from diverse backgrounds – public sector representatives, senior business leaders from multinational corporations and local enterprises across different sectors and key partners, such as NTUC, SNEF and the trade associations and chambers.

key_points.point: A Tripartite Jobs Council co-chaired by NTUC, SNEF and MOM was announced last week to address challenges and opportunities brought by AI.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: This is also why we recently announced, just last week, on Friday, the set-up of a Tripartite Jobs Council, co-chaired by NTUC, SNEF and MOM to bring our collective capabilities to bear on the challenges and the opportunities brought by AI.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo Wan Ling supported the Bill and called for SWDA to establish regular, ongoing engagement with stakeholders continuously.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
key_points.quote: SWDA must establish regular, ongoing engagement with these stakeholders not just at the point of policy design, but continuously.

key_points.point: Mr Gerald Giam supported the Bill notwithstanding concerns and suggested KPIs as a starting framework for accountability.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
key_points.quote: I would therefore suggest the Ministry consider the following KPIs for the agency as a starting framework to ensure better accountability.

key_points.point: Mr Patrick Tay supported the Bill and offered three priorities: high speed, high quality and high returns.
key_points.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
key_points.quote: I offer three priorities for the next bound of Singapore's skills and workforce development ecosystem, what I call the three "highs", not "Hi" but "high" – high speed, high quality and high returns.

key_points.point: Assoc Prof Terence Ho welcomed the merger and asked what plans there are for the MySkillsFuture and MyCareersFuture portals and how user experience can be improved.
key_points.speaker: Assoc Prof Terence Ho
key_points.quote: I would like to ask what the plans are for the two portals, and in particular, how user experience can be improved.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Loh supported the Bill and said anyone looking for a job for more than six months, even a recent graduate, should qualify for the same support.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh
key_points.quote: Anyone looking for a job for more than six months, even a recent graduate, should qualify for the same support.

key_points.point: Dr Neo Kok Beng said aligning skills frameworks with professional accreditation standards would turn lifelong learning into lifelong career advancement.
key_points.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng
key_points.quote: If SWDA can align our skills frameworks with the accreditation standards of these professional institutions, then we will have turned "lifelong learning" into "lifelong career advancement".

key_points.point: Ms Gho Sze Kee supported the Bill and said the approach to SkillsFuture credit caps should be reviewed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gho Sze Kee
key_points.quote: We should review our approach to SkillsFuture credit caps.

key_points.point: Mr Darryl David proposed moving towards a more explicit outcome-based funding model.
key_points.speaker: Mr Darryl David
key_points.quote: I would therefore propose a move towards a more explicit outcome-based funding model.

key_points.point: Ms Elysa Chen supported the Bill because it clarifies mission, tightens safeguards and lays the foundation for a lifelong and person-centred view of work.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen
key_points.quote: I support this Bill because it strengthens three things: it clarifies our mission; it tightens our safeguards; it lays the foundation for a lifelong and person-centred view of work.

key_points.point: Mr Yip Hon Weng supported the intention behind SWDA and asked whether Singapore should move decisively towards a place-and-train model.
key_points.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
key_points.quote: Should we move decisively towards a place-and-train model, where employment is secured upfront and training follows rather than asking residents to train first without a clear job pathway?

key_points.point: Mr Saktiandi Supaat supported the Bill but sought clarifications on underlying principles, perceptions and operational issues.
key_points.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
key_points.quote: I therefore support the Bill to merge and form the SWDA, but I have some clarifications on some of the underlying principles, perceptions and operational issues.

key_points.point: Mr Desmond Choo supported the Bill and said career security is the new social compact.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
key_points.quote: Career security is the new social compact.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng grouped his response into eight broad pillars.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: I have decided to group it into eight broad pillars.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said the joint oversight arrangement is not a two-headed monster but a two-horse chariot pulling in the same direction.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: This is not a two-headed monster. This is a two-horse chariot, pulling in the same direction, charging ahead.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said Government funding for course fees is only applicable for courses offering skills relevant to a specific industry, while the base tier of SkillsFuture Credit applies to a wide range of courses including personal interests.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: While the base tier of SkillsFuture Credit is applicable to a wide range of courses, including those for personal interests, Government funding for course fees is only applicable for courses that offer skills relevant to that specific industry, which will support the workforce's upskilling needs.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said e2i operates 27 out of 31 touchpoints island-wide for career matching and advisory.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: e2i operates 27 out of 31 touchpoints island-wide for career matching and advisory.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said NTUC's Company Training Committee initiative involves $300 million funding to drive enterprise and workforce transformation.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: NTUC is spearheading the Company Training Committee initiative, which involves $300 million funding to drive enterprise and workforce transformation.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said data will be a critical enabler, with SWDA tapping MOM labour market data, demand signals from job postings and training take-up.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Data will be the critical enabler – SWDA will tap on various data sources, including MOM's rich labour market data, demand signals from job postings as well as training take-up.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said the Singapore Opportunity Index has been introduced to provide transparency to job seekers on employers who promote opportunity and deliver strong career outcomes.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: As a first step, we have introduced the Singapore Opportunity Index to provide transparency to job seekers on employers who promote opportunity and deliver strong career outcomes for their workers.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said details of the enhanced Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package will be shared once SWDA comes into existence in July.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The details will be further shared once SWDA comes into existence in July.

key_points.point: In response to Mr Kenneth Tiong, Dr Tan See Leng said if a specific company is highlighted as posting on MyCareersFuture as a paper exercise, the Government will not hesitate to investigate.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: If he can highlight any specific company or instance of companies posting on this particular portal as a paper exercise, we will not hesitate to investigate the company.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said companies that invest in training their workers have seen better retention.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Companies that invest in the training of their workers, whether they work through the NTUC Company Training Committees or they work through our job redesign package, work through WSG's Career Conversion Programmes, have seen better retention for their employees.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said SWDA's integrated intelligence function will provide forward-looking signals on roles and skillsets in demand so students and families can make more informed decisions.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: SWDA's integrated intelligence function will provide forward-looking signals on what roles and what skillsets are in demand, so then this will allow students and even their families in the IHLs to make more informed decisions.

key_points.point: Dr Tan See Leng said core to the success of the exercise requires mindset change.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Core to the success of this entire exercise requires mindset change – and I did make that a very clear point when I first started my speech.

what_happens_next: If the Bill is passed, SWDA will be established in the third quarter of 2026; the Minister said details of the enhanced Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package will be shared once SWDA comes into existence in July.
